$comment: Explicit, justified decisions tools/spec-merge will not take on its own. Every entry needs a reason; an entry that matches nothing fails the merge.

POST /mailcow/orders.reason: The portal gives the Mailcow and SSL order operations the same operationIds (its composed spec merges both services' order packages). The SSL operations keep the names; the Mailcow ones get the service in theirs.

GET /mailcow/orders/{id}.reason: The portal gives the Mailcow and SSL order operations the same operationIds (its composed spec merges both services' order packages). The SSL operations keep the names; the Mailcow ones get the service in theirs.

DELETE /mailcow/domains.reason: The portal uses DeleteDomain for both DELETE /domains/{id} and DELETE /mailcow/domains. The domain service keeps the name.
